title: An analytic approach to the ubiquity of geometric Brascamp-Lieb data
summary: The ubiquity of geometric Brascamp-Lieb data, which means a certain kind of density of geometric data in the set of all feasible Brascamp-Lieb data has been studied recently. Relying substantially on the work of Dvir and Hu, we provide an analytic proof of ubiquity. Our argument also extends to the setting of quiver Brascamp-Lieb data.
